checklist.title: Control
items: JP3 (terminating jumper on the M1 control): INSTALL it. With one run, the control end is the second of the two termination points.
The data bus must have exactly two terminating points in total, never more.

checklist.title: Run 1
items: Mount the M1DBHR inside the M1 enclosure. Connect its +, A, B and − terminals to the control's +VKP, DATA A, DATA B and NEG with a short 4-conductor cable (2 ft). If the hub is powered from an auxiliary supply, do not connect +VKP and join all the negatives.
JP1 (terminates the input from the control): INSTALL it.
Branch 1: terminate the last device (Keypad (address 1)) AND fit JP2 on the hub. That is the branch's two terminations.
Branch 2: home run "A" (50 ft): Keypad (address 2); home run "B" (60 ft): M1XIN (address 3).
Branch 2: terminate the last device of each home run and REMOVE JP3.
Branch 3: not used. Leave JP4 as it is; no devices are connected.
Branch 4: not used. Leave JP5 as it is; no devices are connected.

checklist.title: Addresses to set
items: M1XIN (address 3): zones 33-48; S1 on, S2 on, S3 off, S4 off
After setting the addresses, run Bus Module Enrollment (installer programming, or Live > Modules in this editor). Devices added later must be enrolled too.
